lines.zh: 我抱着账本走，怕它掉进云里。
lines.en: I carry the ledger as if it might fall into cloud.

lines.zh: 塔的台阶窄，我一级一级挪。
lines.en: The tower steps are narrow; I shuffle down one by one.

lines.zh: 金币在袋子里响，我就知道方向。
lines.en: Coins clink in my bag and tell me the way.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，因为清单还没数完。
lines.en: I walk slowly because the list is unfinished.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的风大，账页会飞。
lines.en: Lelyetia's wind is strong; pages take flight.

lines.zh: 我沿着塔外的小路巡视。
lines.en: I patrol the little path outside the tower.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我回头看一眼金库。
lines.en: Every ten steps I glance back at the vault.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底薄，石头硌脚。
lines.en: My soles are thin and the stones bite.

lines.zh: 这根手杖不是武器，是量尺。
lines.en: This cane is not a weapon; it measures.

lines.zh: 我去门口接客人，顺便数人。
lines.en: I go to the door to greet guests and count them.

lines.zh: 盘账的日子，我走得更慢。
lines.en: On audit days I walk even more slowly.

lines.zh: 手里的印章比剑沉。
lines.en: The stamp in my hand is heavier than a sword.

lines.zh: 我把零钱袋换了三次肩。
lines.en: I shift the coin pouch from shoulder to shoulder.

lines.zh: 回去的路我闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I could find the way back with eyes closed.

lines.zh: 我数到第三百枚，又从头开始。
lines.en: I reach coin three hundred and start over.

lines.zh: 窗口没人，我正好核一遍账。
lines.en: No one at the window, so I recheck the books.

lines.zh: 我的笔尖干了，舔一舔再写。
lines.en: My nib dried; I wet it and write on.

lines.zh: 金库的锁我一天摸八次。
lines.en: I touch the vault lock eight times a day.

lines.zh: 汇率贴在墙上，边角卷起来了。
lines.en: The rates are posted on the wall, corners curling.

lines.zh: 我坐着，算盘珠在指下响。
lines.en: I sit and beads click under my fingers.

lines.zh: 账本上有一页空白，我留着。
lines.en: One page of the ledger stays blank; I keep it.

lines.zh: 塔太高，客人常常爬到一半就喘。
lines.en: The tower is tall; guests arrive half out of breath.

lines.zh: 我把硬币按年份排好。
lines.en: I sort the coins by the year they were struck.

lines.zh: 今天一枚假币都没见着。
lines.en: Not a single counterfeit coin today.

lines.zh: 窗外的云比账页白。
lines.en: The clouds outside are whiter than my pages.

lines.zh: 我在心里预演怎么拒绝赊账。
lines.en: I rehearse how to refuse a line of credit.

lines.zh: 手指沾了墨，账本上也沾了。
lines.en: Ink on my fingers, and now on the ledger.

lines.zh: 这栋楼是我的全部家当。
lines.en: This tower is my entire fortune.

lines.zh: 客人，先把剑收起来再谈。
lines.en: Customer, put the sword away before we talk.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，干净，可以碰钱。
lines.en: Let me see your hands; clean enough for coins.

lines.zh: 你是来存，还是来换。
lines.en: Are you here to deposit or to exchange?

lines.zh: 口袋里的声音，比你的话可信。
lines.en: The sound in your pocket is more honest than you.

lines.zh: 别站在柜台外发呆，报个数。
lines.en: Do not daydream at the counter; name a figure.

lines.zh: 我认脸很准，尤其是欠账的脸。
lines.en: I remember faces well, especially those that owe.

lines.zh: 你的靴子带泥，请在外面蹭蹭。
lines.en: Your boots carry mud; scrape them outside first.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，我很清楚自己多脆。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts; I know exactly how fragile I am.

lines.zh: 我从你的眼神看出，你没带钱。
lines.en: Your eyes tell me you brought no money.

lines.zh: 别敲柜台，木头很贵。
lines.en: Do not tap the counter; the wood was costly.

lines.zh: 你是第一个肯抬头看我的人。
lines.en: You are the first to look up at me.

lines.zh: 我们这儿不收承诺，只收硬币。
lines.en: We take coins here, not promises.

lines.zh: 你袖口破了，要不要换点钱补。
lines.en: Your cuff is torn; exchange something to mend it?

lines.zh: 慢慢看，柜台不会跑。
lines.en: Take your time; the counter will not run off.

lines.zh: 高塔里就我一个，你运气好。
lines.en: I am the only one in the tower. Lucky you.

lines.zh: 你先说说要换多少，别磨蹭。
lines.en: Tell me how much you are trading. Do not dawdle.

lines.zh: 打我可以，招牌不能歪。
lines.en: Hit me if you like, but not the signboard.

lines.zh: 账本护住了，我没事。
lines.en: The ledger is safe; I am fine.

lines.zh: 这一下要从我的薪水里扣。
lines.en: That blow comes out of my wages.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，别一次打光。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts; do not spend them all at once.

lines.zh: 我的眼镜碎了，看不清你了。
lines.en: My glasses broke; I can barely see you.

lines.zh: 疼也得记账，亏了要写。
lines.en: Pain must be recorded too; losses must be written.

lines.zh: 墨水洒了，这是你最重的伤。
lines.en: The ink spilled, and that is your worst blow.

lines.zh: 别慌，我还站得起来。
lines.en: Do not worry; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 柜台后的地板很硬，我摔得响。
lines.en: The floor behind the counter is hard; I fell loudly.

lines.zh: 这一下我要写进投诉簿。
lines.en: This goes into the complaint book.

lines.zh: 吃的？我更想要你的硬币。
lines.en: Food? I would rather have your coins.

lines.zh: 别拿面包抵账，这里不认。
lines.en: Do not pay with bread; we do not accept it.

lines.zh: 这果子能换三枚硬币，最多。
lines.en: This fruit gets you three coins at most.

lines.zh: 你请我吃饭，是想免手续费吧。
lines.en: Buying me dinner to dodge the fee, are you?

lines.zh: 我一天只吃一顿，省时间。
lines.en: I eat once a day to save time.

lines.zh: 香味不错，可它不进账本。
lines.en: It smells fine, but it does not enter the ledger.

lines.zh: 先谈完这笔生意，再谈吃的。
lines.en: Let us finish this deal, then discuss food.

lines.zh: 你的胡萝卜我按两根一币收。
lines.en: I will take your carrot at two per coin.

lines.zh: 柜台上有规矩，不吃东西。
lines.en: The counter has rules; no eating here.

lines.zh: 我胃口小，账单大。
lines.en: My appetite is small; my bills are not.

lines.zh: 当心！账本比你重要。
lines.en: Careful! The ledger matters more than you do.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了我三枚硬币。
lines.en: You knocked three coins out of my hand.

lines.zh: 别挤柜台，排队的人会乱。
lines.en: Do not crowd the counter; the queue will break.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，经不起推。
lines.en: These old bones cannot take a shove.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的鞋了，退一步。
lines.en: You stepped on my shoe; step back.

lines.zh: 单子飞了，先抓纸再抓我。
lines.en: The forms flew; grab the paper before me.

lines.zh: 撞我也要赔的，按次收费。
lines.en: Bumping me costs money; the rate is per hit.

lines.zh: 我扶住柜台，才没摔倒。
lines.en: I caught the counter, or I would have fallen.

lines.zh: 你的护甲太硬，硌得我手疼。
lines.en: Your armor is too hard; it hurt my hand.

lines.zh: 请保持一米，这是行规。
lines.en: Please keep one meter back; those are the rules.

lines.zh: 我娶了这栋塔，嫁妆是金库。
lines.en: I married this tower; the dowry was the vault.

lines.zh: 账目比人可靠，我早想通了。
lines.en: Numbers are more reliable than people; I settled that long ago.

lines.zh: 没有同行愿意爬这么高的楼。
lines.en: No colleague will climb this many stairs.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这本翻旧的账本。
lines.en: My partner is this worn ledger.

lines.zh: 谈感情要花时间，时间能换钱。
lines.en: Romance costs time, and time converts to money.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂太高，没人愿意上来。
lines.en: Lelyetia is too high; nobody comes up.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也心动过，一次。
lines.en: I had a flutter once, when I was young.

lines.zh: 同行之间只谈汇率。
lines.en: Among bankers, we discuss only exchange rates.

lines.zh: 孤独不用记账，也算省事。
lines.en: Loneliness is not booked, which saves trouble.

lines.zh: 柜台后面一个人，刚好。
lines.en: One person behind the counter is just right.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，一律算遗失物。
lines.en: Anything on the floor counts as lost property.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，先看清年份。
lines.en: I pick it up and check the year first.

lines.zh: 这一枚有缺口，值七折。
lines.en: This coin has a chip; it is worth seventy percent.

lines.zh: 我把零钱按面值分格放。
lines.en: I sort small coins into slots by value.

lines.zh: 捡钱的动作，我练了三十年。
lines.en: I have practiced picking up coins for thirty years.

lines.zh: 这滩水里有东西在反光。
lines.en: Something in that puddle is catching light.

lines.zh: 地上捡的，得登记一下。
lines.en: What I find on the floor must be logged.

lines.zh: 别抢，这是本行的手艺。
lines.en: Do not snatch; spotting money is my trade.

lines.zh: 你掉的硬币我替你存着，利息照算。
lines.en: I will hold your dropped coin, interest included.

lines.zh: 纸片我捡，硬币我更捡。
lines.en: I pick up paper, and coins even more so.

lines.zh: 又一位客人，请排队。
lines.en: Another customer; please join the queue.

lines.zh: 我听见口袋响，就转头了。
lines.en: I heard a pocket clink and turned around.

lines.zh: 你身上有生意味，我闻得出。
lines.en: You smell of business; I can tell.

lines.zh: 别急着走，我们还没谈完。
lines.en: Do not rush off; we are not finished talking.

lines.zh: 有动静，我先把金库锁上。
lines.en: Something stirs; let me lock the vault first.

lines.zh: 你的东西我估价了，很高。
lines.en: I have appraised your goods; they rate high.

lines.zh: 柜台开了，你要不要办。
lines.en: The counter is open; will you do business?

lines.zh: 站到线后面，我看得清些。
lines.en: Stand behind the line so I can see clearly.

lines.zh: 嘘，账目不能外传。
lines.en: Hush; the books are not for outside ears.

lines.zh: 今天我心情好，汇率给你优惠。
lines.en: I am in a good mood; favorable rate for you.

lines.zh: 我盯着钱袋，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I am watching your purse, not your face.

lines.zh: 你数钱的手法很生疏。
lines.en: You count money like a beginner.

lines.zh: 别把手伸到柜台下面。
lines.en: Keep your hands out from under the counter.

lines.zh: 我在算你换完后还剩多少。
lines.en: I am calculating what you have left after exchange.

lines.zh: 你这笔交易，我盯了全程。
lines.en: I watched this transaction from start to finish.

lines.zh: 慢一点，硬币会掉。
lines.en: Slow down; the coins will spill.

lines.zh: 你的同伙在门外等着吧。
lines.en: Your companion is waiting outside the door, yes?

lines.zh: 金库的门只开三秒。
lines.en: The vault door opens for three seconds only.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我记账。
lines.en: I do not chase people; I record them.

lines.zh: 你的名字我会写进本子里。
lines.en: Your name goes into my book.

lines.zh: 我用印章砸你，很疼的。
lines.en: I strike you with my stamp; it does sting.

lines.zh: 这手杖平时量货，也能打人。
lines.en: This cane measures goods and can also hit.

lines.zh: 别逼我动手，我手很薄。
lines.en: Do not make me swing; my hands are thin.

lines.zh: 一下，就一下，别怪我。
lines.en: One blow, just one; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 账本我要留着，不给你挡刀。
lines.en: The ledger stays with me; it will not block blades.

lines.zh: 我的力气全在手指上。
lines.en: All my strength lives in my fingers.

lines.zh: 你抢钱，我就敲你手背。
lines.en: Reach for the cash and I rap your knuckles.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，我知道自己撑不了。
lines.en: Thirty health; I know I cannot last long.

lines.zh: 这一下算手续费。
lines.en: Consider that blow a service fee.

lines.zh: 别砸柜台，那比我的命贵。
lines.en: Do not smash the counter; it costs more than my life.

lines.zh: 今日开张，账本已备好。
lines.en: The counter opens today; the ledger is ready.

lines.zh: 我爬上塔顶，把印章摆正。
lines.en: I climbed to the top and squared the stamp.

lines.zh: 窗口擦过了，就等客人。
lines.en: The window is wiped; now I wait.

lines.zh: 金库清点完毕，一把锁。
lines.en: Vault counted: one lock, all present.

lines.zh: 这栋塔的旧账，我接手了。
lines.en: I have taken on this tower's old accounts.

lines.zh: 第一天营业，汇率要写大些。
lines.en: First day of business; write the rates large.

lines.zh: 我把椅子搬到窗边。
lines.en: I drag my chair over to the window.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的云离得很近。
lines.en: The clouds of Lelyetia hang very close.

lines.zh: 账本翻开第一页，空白。
lines.en: I open the ledger to a blank first page.

lines.zh: 来的人不多，但都带钱。
lines.en: Few visitors come, but they bring money.

lines.zh: 火烧到账本，我扑得比谁都快。
lines.en: The ledger caught fire and I moved fastest.

lines.zh: 从台阶滚下去，硬币先落地。
lines.en: I tumbled down the stairs; the coins landed first.

lines.zh: 水进来，我先记账本的位置。
lines.en: Water came in, so I noted the ledger's place.

lines.zh: 炸波掀翻柜台，印章还在手里。
lines.en: The blast flipped the counter; the stamp stayed in hand.

lines.zh: 箭钉住我的袖口，正好。
lines.en: The arrow pinned my cuff, which is convenient.

lines.zh: 药水味让我想起发霉的纸。
lines.en: Potion smell reminds me of moldy paper.

lines.zh: 饿着算账，数字会变得温柔。
lines.en: Counting hungry makes the numbers look kind.

lines.zh: 雷打在塔尖，账页全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the spire and lit every page.

lines.zh: 虚空里没法开户，太可惜。
lines.en: One cannot open an account in the void; a pity.
